description: A meeting transcript as a starting point: WebVTT (Zoom, Teams, Otter) or "Name: words" lines. The transcript goes on the shelves with its decisions; the questions raised join the open questions; the claims made come back to check, with who said them. Nothing becomes a finding. verify=true files one research run that checks the claims. Paths from the keeper only.

path.description: The transcript on this machine (absolute path).

patron.description: Optional: who is asking ? {did, name, runtime}. Anonymous when absent.

title.description: The meeting's name (default: the file name).

verify.description: File one research run that checks the claims.

name: library_meeting
